source_note: Control identifiers and titles were checked against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Release 5.2.0 catalog materials. Applicability and rationale are project mapping decisions and remain draft.

mappings.title: Least Privilege
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when a vendor integration receives access to organizational systems or information.
mappings.rationale: Use as a review prompt for whether vendor permissions are limited to the access needed for the service. This mapping does not assess implementation or effectiveness.

mappings.title: Event Logging
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when the service processes organizational information or performs actions whose activity needs to be reviewed.
mappings.rationale: Use as a prompt to ask what security-relevant activity is logged and how the customer can obtain or review it. The mapping is not evidence that logging exists.

mappings.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when organizational users authenticate to the vendor service.
mappings.rationale: Use as a prompt to review how organizational users are identified and authenticated, including the authentication claims and related evidence provided for the service.

mappings.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
mappings.applicability_note: Relevant when information is transmitted to, from, or through the vendor service.
mappings.rationale: Use as a prompt to review protections for information in transit. The mapping does not establish that a particular protection is implemented or sufficient.
